local.lintDetail: The Expo lint wrapper selected Bun from bun.lock, Bun was unavailable, and the wrapper returned success without executing ESLint.

defects.title: GitHub Actions cannot start jobs for the exact candidate
defects.impact: Exact-head hosted CI, security, CodeQL, review, and generated evidence jobs cannot execute, so the candidate cannot be promoted.
defects.remediation: Restore GitHub Actions execution at the organization billing or spending-control boundary, then create fresh runs for the current candidate SHA.

defects.title: The lint gate can report success without executing ESLint

evidence.wrapperOutput: 'bun' is not recognized as an internal or external command

defects.impact: The candidate's recorded lint success is invalid and actual source findings remain unresolved.
defects.remediation: Remove the conflicting Bun lock, invoke repository ESLint directly, exclude only generated or archived non-product trees, and resolve the remaining production lint findings before promotion.

resolvedFromPriorCandidate.evidence: A clean npm ci completed under Node 22.23.2/npm 11.13.0.
The pinned Node 22.23.2 runtime satisfies the locked dependency graph.
